This chain of interactions implies that Imipramine may influence the activity of Slc22a2 through its interaction with Cyp3a7 and Propranolol. The lowest common ancestor of these interactions is the class of organic cyclic compounds, suggesting a broader biochemical pathway. The evidence supports a mechanistic link where Imipramine's effects on Cyp3a7 could modulate Propranolol's interaction with Slc22a2, potentially affecting drug transport.
